studies.baselineLabel: Legacy travel timing under the proposed fixed-shift/return-reserve policy

assumptions.assumptionStatus: Illustrative sensitivity inputs, not representative native traffic or fuel calibration. No use of the 1 m/s, 31 m native probe.
assumptions.units: coordinates/straight distance: metres; physical speed: metres/real second; time: game minutes; 1 real second = 1 game minute; fuel: litres; currency: game dollars

policy.calendar: 2026-05-04 Monday through 2026-05-10 Sunday, illustrative dry May week, same route each day; default market fallback 100, CLI override and game-price per-item market supported
policy.shift: Two employees each 07:00–19:00, fixed 12 hours/day each, 168 employee-hours/week, extra wages zero. Wage formula as pass report but fixed shifts differ from Core AutoSchedule/pay in pass; do not directly compare those profits. Not a payroll forecast for other modpacks.
policy.dispatch: Load at depot 07:00. Depart each pitch only at its fixed close (even sold out); wait if early; late arrival trims service. Reserve direct home travel time before service, and direct home fuel plus reserve before dispatch. Skip a stop if no positive service fits or return fuel fails. Return after last window. No roadside food restock, no overtime, teleport or daily state reset.
policy.fuel: Pre-departure full planned day forecast plus reserve triggers at most one synthetic station loop per morning. Must reach station on existing fuel; fill actual empty capacity there, engine off during service, then return to depot. Full tank must cover station-back, full day forecast and reserve, else explicit infeasible. Engine idles only during per-leg lights/parking waits, off during selling/loading/filling. Fuel inventory carried across week; consumption expensed at reference price incl initial tank; purchases reported as cash separately. Legacy uses no fuel.
policy.geometry: Actual city building and commissary address map anchors, all in the same regional map frame. Native bay coordinates are excluded because they use a different frame; bay offset is unknown. Straight-line × assumed road factor is not a measured road route. Synthetic station has no claimed real access/reservation. Cross-region travel never selected. Prior map-scale study suggests distances may be off 15–35%; this is not a confidence interval or native route calibration.
policy.selection: Rank actual district spots by Wednesday 08:00–18:00 full-menu unconstrained demand integral; floor(q*(N-1)), tie ordinal address. That fixes the first pitch only. For each configured short/local or long total straight-distance band [minimum, maximum), enumerate distinct second/third pitches in the same district/region. Select maximum summed Wednesday nominal-window stock contribution (revenue minus sold COGS) at 11:30–14:30 and 14:30–18:00, each scored separately from the common full stock target; ties shorter total distance, then ordinal second/third address. This purposeful bounded heuristic favours downstream contributions but ignores stock carryover/travel in its selection score; actual economics models both. Bands include depot outward and final return. Missing candidate bands are reported, never silently replaced. Fixed adjacent windows 08:00–11:30, 11:30–14:30, 14:30–18:00 have zero transfer slack, so every move consumes the next window (negative baseline transition slack emitted). No traffic-adaptive retiming. Matched stay: greatest legacy-policy weekly operating profit among the three pitches at continuous 08:00–18:00; tie ordinal address. All selection is baseline only and frozen before physical results. Illustrative cases with selection bias, not representative player routes or global optima.
policy.supply: Start empty at depot on Monday; morning top-up to common full per-piece target, retain leftovers. Sufficient commissary stock before 07:00 assumed (carryover/logistics), no daily order-arrival simulation. COGS only on sold units. No spoilage, regulars, health, competition, pitch fees or sales tax. Inventory valued consistently at supplied wholesale prices.
policy.profitScope: Pre-tax operating profit after sold stock COGS, fixed wages, commissary rent, allocated delivery and consumed fuel; excludes capex/depreciation, financing, licensing/permits, maintenance, damage, fines and personal labour. Realized operating balance always retains actual revenue and incurred costs, including wages on zero-sales/infeasible days; it is not a completed-route profitability claim. Infeasible home returns/no-service days give null ordinary profit; skipped-stop home completions explicitly denote reduced operation with infeasible original schedule.
policy.metrics: Open minutes are permitted service interval even if stock sells out; sales minutes are Selling.Run stocked simulation minutes (5-minute expected-rate steps), not a count of busy cashier time. Closed minutes are scheduled window minus open time. Lunch loss uses 11:30–14:30. Missed demand is unconstrained full-menu demand in closed intervals at their actual clock times, not guaranteed lost sales. SoldOutItems counts only items with positive opening/loaded stock, positive actual sales and ending stock <= 1e-6; an empty unserved item is not exhaustion. SoldOutItemDays counts such days by item over the week. Deltas compare the same alternative to the stated legacy-policy baseline. Opportunity loss is explanatory and is never expensed again. Refuel loop overlap is raw overlap with scheduled 08:00–18:00, not a causal estimate of additional lost sales.

studies.caveats: No representative timing/fuel calibration. 1 real second = 1 game minute is an assumed code-based scale, not verified here against the native clock. Excludes actual road graph, parking/access failures, stochastic traffic/jams, regulars/reputation and health/competition feedback, and service after 18:00 including nightlife. Mild 3/10-minute per-leg waits and 15-minute station service are hypothetical (3/10/15 real seconds under the assumed scale), not typical traffic/filling estimates. Fixed windows and no adaptive retiming can overstate losses versus a player who adapts; only the matched stay models adaptation. Selection score can bias results and is not an optimized finite-stock route.

Sold-out counting includes carried/loaded stock actually sold to zero, excluding empty unserved, unsold and remaining items.
Comparison/sensitivity status text and reduced-speed classification distinguish skipped-stop reduced operation, full completion and infeasibility.
Legacy uses exact Core timer and no fuel (zero, fractional and long distances).
Purposeful downstream selection uses baseline nominal-window contribution and actual total distance within its declared band.
Zero-wait fuel-disabled physical control exactly matches legacy trips, economics, stock and daily intervals (only assumed road-length metadata differs).
800 assumed road metres at 8 m/s takes 100 game minutes + 3 wait, no factor 60.
Identical scenarios produce identical full weekly economics and traces.
All cases pay the same two 12-hour shifts for seven days; extra wages zero.
Monday starts empty; all days/cases load to identical full per-piece targets at the depot, never scenario-demand targets.
Next day starts with prior day's exact stock and fuel, no daily reset.
Finite stock is consumed across stops, no roadside refill, no piece over capacity or negative stock.
No service before loading/arrival, during travel or outside fixed pitch windows.
Daily and weekly fuel conservation: start + purchased − consumed = end, bounded by finite tank.
COGS is sold units only; profit expenses consumed fuel including initial inventory, never purchase cash twice.
All cases use the configured morning loading duration before any departure (default 30 game minutes, matching Core restock).
Diagnostic 1/2 m/s and 0/30/90/180 wait fixtures use game minutes and idle fuel with no factor 60.
Low-tank stress exercises bounded station loop, actual empty-capacity fill and full declared service/travel time.
Unreachable station at zero fuel is explicit infeasible; no free recovery, fill, sales or ordinary profit.
Extreme physical delay skips all missed windows, never sells afterwards; shift-infeasible/no-service outcome is explicit.
Infeasible zero-sales operation retains actual fixed-cost losses in realized balance while ordinary profit remains null.
Impossible day/station tank requirement is explicit infeasible and cannot mint fuel.
Homeward travel is reserved before serving; ordinary operating results complete home within paid shift.
Real city demand/sales differ at 11:00 versus 14:30; Selling evaluates delayed demand at actual clock time.
A controlled arrival delayed from 08:00 to 11:30 sells at actual lunch demand and differs from backdated morning sales.
Actually late study visits match actual-time Selling intervals, never nominal scheduled-time sales.
Matched single is selected from moving pitches under legacy only and remains frozen for all scenarios.
Seven actual weekdays are used, with demand varying between weekday and weekend.
Configuration rejects invalid speed, nonfinite fuel, overfull start, unsupported schema/units and out-of-range ranks.
